error.season_order: The season switch points must be in this order: Winter from < Winter until ≤ Summer until < Summer from.
error.no_hot_water: Hot water is not enabled for this heat pump (device settings).
error.ct_not_running: The compressor isn't running right now. Enter the CT value while it runs.
error.ct_r32_only: Calibration with the CT current works for R32 models only.
error.ct_implausible: That CT value doesn't fit the current frequency. Check the value and try again during a steady run.

power.test_no_meter: No external meter linked. Pick one via Repair or on the app settings page.
power.meter_missing: The linked energy meter no longer exists (removed or paired again). Pick it again via Repair or on the app settings page; until then the estimate is used.
power.test_unavailable: Meter __name__ is unavailable right now; the estimate is used.

settings.subtitle: Global app settings. Connection details (IP, port, unit ID, poll interval, features) are in each heat pump's device settings.
settings.meter_help: Already measuring a heat pump with a separate energy meter in Homey (for example a Shelly EM on its circuit)? Each heat pump has its own meter: pick it with Edit next to that heat pump. The heat pump then shows the measured power and energy instead of the estimate; the estimate keeps running for comparison and takes over when the meter is unavailable. Afterwards, in Homey Energy, include the heat pump and exclude the meter device, so nothing is counted twice.
settings.debug_help: Logs every Modbus request/response to the app log. Useful when debugging a new install; turn it off once things work.
settings.meter_label: Energy meter for this heat pump
settings.status_estimate: No meter: the estimate is used
settings.status_unavailable: Meter __name__ is unavailable; the estimate is used
settings.repair_help: Already measuring a heat pump with a separate energy meter in Homey (for example a Shelly EM on its circuit)? Pick it here.
